name: Mr_Simba
bio:
Mr_Simba, also known as Jake, is the Owner and Developer behind Silver Springs Survival. He first found the server when a new friend on his dorm floor showed it to him during his first week of college.

He stayed because of the tight-knit community, open-minded atmosphere, and simple rules built around common sense. Today, creating new content for Silver Springs is his favorite part of the game—and his main creative outlet.

Jake’s favorite project is the current Silver Springs Village spawn. He enjoys that it captures the server’s personality and gives the community something to build on across maps. One of his favorite memories is meeting his wife through Silver Springs.

Jake describes Silver Springs as a possible “forever server” for many players: a place with something unique for people who are willing to give it a try. Outside of Minecraft, he enjoys Outer Wilds.
history: Simba first became a Moderator March 9th of 2014, then became Developer on April 27 the same year, and has been the Owner since January 15th of 2015.
